title: Large cities of Latin America and the Caribbean (timed)
intro: 10 large cities of Latin America and the Caribbean, one after another. You have 45 seconds for each city; at zero your marker is locked in. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.
